description: Intent taxonomy and examples for conversational support classification.

intents.description: Customer initiates contact or asks for help in a general way.
Customer has trouble logging in or accessing the account.
Customer requests or needs password reset help.
Customer asks where an order or shipment is.
Customer reports a billing irregularity or invoice problem.
Customer asks for a receipt or billing statement.
Customer reports a failed transaction or payment decline.
Customer requests reimbursement or refund.
Customer wants to return an item.
Customer requests replacing an item with another size or item.
Customer wants product information or specs.
Customer reports a system or app malfunction.
Customer needs device or app setup guidance.
Customer wants to upgrade plan or service level.
Customer wants to cancel a plan or service.
Customer wants to change one plan to another or adjust features.
Customer needs account validation or security checks.
Customer asks about privacy, deletion, or data usage.
Customer files a complaint about service or fulfillment.
Customer asks for manager or supervisor intervention.
Customer asks about support or service policy details.
Customer wants to change the shipping destination.
Customer files a warranty request or asks if covered.
Customer asks if an item is in stock or ready to ship.
Customer gives praise or criticism about the service.
Customer wants to schedule a support or onboarding call.
Customer is asking for enterprise or business account support.
